text: Sorry if this is a long one, I've been on since 6am and I'm running on fumes. I'm a childminder and I've got a little boy, 5, staying late because his parents are stuck. His temperature is 39.5, I think, I've done it a couple of times and it's around there each time. Earlier this evening he bumped his head on the edge of the table while running about. He cried straight away, proper loud, then calmed down after a cuddle. Since then he's been completely himself, I'd say. Playing, talking, cheeky as usual, nothing different that I can see. I'm not sure if the bump and the temperature have anything to do with each other or if I'm just tired and joining dots that aren't there. I've let the parents know and they're on their way, but I wanted to ask someone properly before handing him over so I can tell them what to do. Is there anything I should be watching for tonight or is this a normal kind of evening for a kid with a temperature, if that makes sense.
